title: event_sqs Module
content_markdown:
The event_sqs module is an implementation of an Amazon SQS producer. It serves as a transport backend for the Event Interface and also provides a stand-alone connector to be used from the OpenSIPS script in order to publish messages to SQS queues.

[https://aws.amazon.com/sqs/](https://aws.amazon.com/sqs/)

dependencies_required.name: AWS SDK for C++
dependencies_required.reason: The following libraries or applications must be installed before running OpenSIPS with this module loaded

exported_parameters.name: queue_url
exported_parameters.description:
This parameter specifies the configuration for an SQS queue that can be used to publish messages directly from the script, using the sqs\_publish\_message() function or to send messages using raise\_event function.

The format of the parameter is: \[ID\]sqs\_url, where ID is an identifier for this SQS queue instance and sqs\_url is the full url of the queue.

The queue\_url contains:

*   _endpoint_
    
*   _region_
exported_parameters.notes: This parameter can be set multiple times.

exported_functions.name: sqs_publish_message

parameters.name: queue_id
parameters.description: The ID of the SQS queue. Must be one of the IDs defined through the `queue_url` modparam.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: The payload of the message to publish.

exported_functions.description: Publishes a message to an SQS queue. As the actual send operation is done asynchronously, this function does not block and returns immediately after queuing the message for sending.

configuration_examples.title: Event-Driven Messaging with _Event Interface_
configuration_examples.description: OpenSIPS' event interface can be utilized to send messages to SQS by subscribing to an event and raising it when needed.
configuration_examples.code:
subscribe_event("MY_EVENT",
	"sqs:http://sqs.us-east-1.localhost.localstack.cloud:4566/000000000000/Queue2");
		
opensips-cli -x mi event_subscribe MY_EVENT \
	  sqs:http://sqs.us-east-1.localhost.localstack.cloud:4566/000000000000/Queue2
		
opensips-cli -x mi raise_event MY_EVENT 'OpenSIPS Message'
